# MatchTune

> > MatchTune is an AI-powered music audit and compliance platform detecting unauthorized usage, deepfakes, and licensing violations across 11+ social platforms.

MatchTune partners with major record labels (UMG, Sony, BMG) to help brands, creators, and rights holders protect music assets and maintain copyright compliance. The platform combines AI detection tools with comprehensive auditing services to identify infringement risks across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and other platforms.

## Music Licensing & Compliance Guides

- [Music Copyright On Social Media: How Brands Can Safely Use Music](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/music-copyright-compliance-on-social-media-how-brands-can-safely-use-music): Guide for brands navigating music copyright compliance across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube
- [The Complete Guide to Music Licensing for Social Media Advertising](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/the-complete-guide-to-music-licensing-for-social-media-advertising): Comprehensive music licensing guide for social media advertising across Meta platforms
- [Instagram Reels & Music Licensing: What Businesses Need to Know](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/instagram-reels-music-licensing-what-businesses-need-to-know): Instagram Reels music licensing guide for businesses navigating legal risks
- [Understanding Personal and Commercial Music Use Online](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/understanding-the-difference-between-personal-and-commercial-music-use-online): Clarifies personal vs. commercial music use distinctions across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube

## Copyright Risk & Infringement Prevention

- [Avoiding Music Copyright Infringement: Why Brands Need Music Audits](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/avoiding-music-copyright-infringement-in-social-media-why-every-brand-needs-a-music-audit): Case for proactive music audits to protect brands from copyright infringement lawsuits
- [How Brands Are Getting Copyright Strikes — and How to Avoid Them](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/how-brands-are-getting-copyright-strikes-and-how-to-avoid-them): Guide on avoiding copyright strikes, takedowns, and legal claims for brands
- [Influencer Marketing and Music Copyright: The Hidden Risk](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/influencer-marketing-and-music-copyright-the-hidden-risk-brands-can-t-ignore): Explores copyright risks when influencers use unlicensed music in TikTok, Instagram Reels

## AI, Deepfakes & Future Threats

- [The Next Wave: Future AI Threats to Music Rights](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/the-next-wave-future-ai-threats-that-could-reshape-music-rights-forever): Emerging AI threats including deepfake vocals and unauthorized AI training on music
- [The Unauthorized Symphony: Big Tech's Exploitation of Music in AI](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/the-unauthorized-symphony-big-tech-s-exploitation-of-music-in-ai-training): Analysis of Big Tech's unlicensed music use in AI training and music industry impact
- [AI-Generated Music and the Sync Industry: A Looming Disruption](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/ai-generated-music-and-the-sync-industry-a-looming-disruption): Impact of AI platforms like Suno, Udio, Boomy on sync licensing and composer livelihoods
- [When Imitation Crosses the Line: Studio Ghibli AI Controversy](https://www.matchtune.com/blog/when-imitation-crosses-the-line-what-the-studio-ghibli-ai-controversy-tells-us-about-the-future-of): Analysis of Studio Ghibli AI controversy and implications for music rights future
